packet.title: Public API for Phase 2 (design)
packet.summary: Extends processor.h and xpath.h with decimal formats, collations, default language, resource kinds, environment variables, a trace and message sink, and the API version macro.

body.p: After the Phase 1 gate. Owns include/sxml/processor.h, include/sxml/xpath.h, include/sxml/version.h. Adds, as fields that designated initializers keep compatible (): decimal formats (named and default, every property of F&O 4.0 "Defining a decimal format", 4.0 c:rendition forms); known collation URIs and the default collation; default language; resource kinds TEXT (encoding), BINARY, COLLECTION, URI_COLLECTION, XQUERY_MODULE, XSLT_MODULE and XSLT_PACKAGE (the later ones are used by 3.11, 4.3, 4.14); host environment variables; a trace and message sink (fn:trace, fn:message, xsl:message); the API version macro of the first release. Done when header check, lints and the rubric pass and 2.12 and 2.16 can be written against the headers alone. Done 2026-10-17 (): header check, lint and debug, debug-gcc, wasm pass; XP40 23,146 and the slice 198/198 unchanged. 2.12 defines sxml_collation_is_supported and sxml_stream_trace_sink.
